appDescription: Start, stop and resume Kimai time entries from the system tray.
notConfigured: The app is not configured yet.
searchEmpty: No entry has this text in its description.
billableOn: Billable to the client - click to keep these hours off the invoice
billableOff: Not billable (internal) - click to bill these hours to the client
billableRowOn: Billable - click to keep this entry off the invoice
billableRowOff: Not billable - click to put this entry on the invoice
billableLocked: Your Kimai account is not allowed to change how this is billed (edit_billable_own_timesheet).
errDescShort: The description is too short — write at least {chars} characters.
errDescGeneric: “{word}” tells the client nothing. Write what you are actually doing.
errTagsDropped: Kimai did not save the tags {tags} — only accounts with that permission may create new tags. Pick existing ones.
errFieldsDenied: Saved, but Kimai does not let your account change billable.
errBeginFuture: The start cannot be in the future.
errEndBeforeBegin: The end has to be later than the start.
errBillableDenied: Your Kimai account cannot set billable / not billable. The entry was saved the way the project defines it. An administrator grants this with the edit_billable_own_timesheet permission.
errUnexpected: Kimai returned an unexpected response — check the address or your network (for example a Wi-Fi login page).
errForbidden: Kimai does not allow this change — the entry is locked (for example exported) or your account lacks the permission.
errExported: This entry has been exported (for example invoiced) — Kimai does not allow changing it.
errRedirect: Kimai has moved to {url} — enter this address in the settings.
errTls: The Kimai server certificate is not trusted.
errAuth: Token rejected or expired. Check it in the settings.
warnHttp: The address uses http:// — the token would travel unencrypted.
warnTimezoneMissing: Your Kimai server does not report the account timezone. Times are recorded in this computer's zone ({system}) — make sure your Kimai profile uses the same zone.
warnTimezone: Your Kimai timezone ({kimai}) differs from this computer's ({system}). Times are recorded in the Kimai timezone — check your Kimai profile.
optTokenHint: Kimai panel: Profile > API. The token is not your login password.
optMinDescHint: 0 turns the check off. 15 is a good default.
hintNoTray: No system tray was found, so DK Tracker runs as a regular window. On GNOME, install the “AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support” extension to get a tray icon.
secretsUnavailable: The system password store is unavailable, so the token cannot be saved. Create a wallet in KDE Wallet Manager or in “Passwords and Keys” (GNOME).
secretsLocked: The password wallet is locked. Unlock it so DK Tracker can read the token.
optLongTimer: Remind about a long timer after (hours)
optNotifyMenu: Confirm start and stop from the icon menu
optAutostartReason: DK Tracker shows in the tray whether you are tracking time.
optAutostartDenied: The system did not allow autostart.
optTokenStored: saved in the wallet — type a new one to change it
optTokenKeep: A token is saved in the wallet. Leave this empty to keep it.
optDailyNormHint: Summaries compare the average per working day with it. 0 — no norm.
optAboutText: Time tracking in Kimai from the system tray and a window on the Linux desktop. An independent project, not an official Kimai app.
optLicense: GPL-3.0-or-later licence · no telemetry — it talks only to your Kimai.
errRunningMove: A running entry cannot be moved — change its start in the timer bar.
